Module com.example.miniproyecto_50zo
Package com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver
public class GameController extends Object implements GameObserver
Main controller for the Cincuentazo game screen. Implements GameObserver to receive and respond to model events, and connects user interactions from the GUI to the GameModel. Manages card rendering, turn flow, keyboard shortcuts, and player elimination display.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the controller after the FXML is loaded. Creates the game model, starts the game, sets up event handlers, renders the initial state, and starts the first turn if it belongs to a machine.

    • setupKeyboardShortcuts

      private void setupKeyboardShortcuts()
      Registers keyboard shortcuts on the scene once it becomes available. Keys 1-4 play the card at the corresponding hand index. SPACE draws a card from the deck.

    • handlePlayCardAtIndex

      private void handlePlayCardAtIndex(int index)
      Plays the card at the given index in the human player's hand.
      Parameters:
      index - the zero-based index of the card in the hand

    • renderHand

      private void renderHand(javafx.scene.layout.HBox container, List<Card> hand, boolean isMachine, double width, double height)
      Renders a player's hand into the given container. Human cards show their front image with a click handler. Machine cards show their back image with no interaction.
      Parameters:
      container - the HBox to populate
      hand - the list of cards to render
      isMachine - true if the hand belongs to a machine player
      width - the display width for each card image
      height - the display height for each card image

    • handlePlayCard

      private void handlePlayCard(Card card)
      Handles the human player's attempt to play a card. Validates that it is the human's turn and that they have not already played this turn.
      Parameters:
      card - the card the human wants to play
